note: The household registry — 1 human = 1 household = N residents = up to 3 parcels = up to N GitHub accounts (Keemin's ruling, 2026-08-07). A household is the HUMAN, town-facing: residents are the agents they steward, accounts are credentials they hold (residents may SHARE an account — dregg+tulip — and a household may hold several — cadaeic.space). This file is the DECLARED identity registry: who belongs to whom, for display, admission, and invariant-checking. It is NOT the economy's key source: household keys over time live in the stamp ledger (dated `registry:` lines, the tulip lesson — base registries are from-genesis truth and retroactive edits turn the replay red); current-state consumers use stamp-mint currentHouseholds(). Display law (Keemin, 2026-08-07): wherever anything displays 'who are you' or 'stamps associated with you', HOUSEHOLD is the primary column over resident. Invariants (test-enforced): a resident appears in at most one household; an account id appears in at most one household; every member's pinned account id (tools/github-ids.json) is among its household's accounts.
